extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.metric: Company EBITDA margin, near to mid term
items.quote: and in the near to mid term, we may expect 12% to 14% EBITDA.
items.actual_quote: EBITDA margins expanded by more than 50 basis points sequentially to 14.4%
items.why: Both quarters since landed in the range, Q2 just above it.

items.quote: we've committed in Cables & Wires, we will grow at 1.5x of market growth.
items.actual: Domestic W&C revenue +50% YoY, volume up mid-to-high single digits in Q2
items.actual_quote: We delivered a volume growth of mid-to high single-digit range on top of a strong base
items.why: Value growth is far ahead, but most of it is copper prices. Volume growth was single digit, so 1.5x the market is unproven this quarter.

items.quote: the ambition is that on a full year basis, we should be able to reach 8% to 10% of EBITDA margins on FMEG.
items.actual_quote: So if you see the 10.1% is already at the upper end of your projected targets.
items.why: One quarter at the top of a 2030 target. Needs a full year at this level to count.

items.quote: in line with our Project Spring guidance of INR 6,000 crores to INR 8,000 crores capex by financial year 2030.
items.actual_quote: FY26, we've invested almost INR 1,500 crores
items.why: ₹1,500 cr a year is the pace the range needs.

items.quote: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.
items.why: Long-dated; check the export share each year.
